cues.text: Ken stands alone in an alley. Akihiko walks up.
Akihiko turns and walks out of sight, leaving Ken alone.
Ken covers his face with his hands and cries.
Ken closes his eyes. A flash.
A slender blue Persona hovers, a blade atop its head.
Now it has two caged spheres on long legs.
Back in the alley, sparks sink into Ken.
